# Icon Colors

```tsx
import { IconColors, iconColorsVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para destacar um ícone, reforçando significado, hierarquia ou status.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  {colors.map((color) => (
    <IconColors key={color} {...args} color={color} />
  ))}
</div>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Icon Colors component: Color × Container, with the Icon swappable for any Hugeicons icon.

## Variants

`iconColorsVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `accent`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` | `accent` |
| `container` | `true`, `false` | `false` |

## Rules

- Import `IconColors` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
